thread:
alex: Heads up — seeing a 12-18% tail latency bump on host-side parsing for small requests after last week's mini-scheduler tweak. gRPC writev times look worse on canaries. Profiling attached.

mira: Ugh. Which paths are hot? kv-cache hit rate stable?

alex: kv hit-rate unchanged. Flame samples point to more time in host_parse -> writev -> epoll_wait. Looks like more frequent flushes of tiny frames.

jordan: Could the scheduler change have lowered coalescing headroom? We adjusted micro-batch flush thresholds last deploy.

alex: That's my suspicion. Here's a quick stack sample from staging (perf top, summed stacks):

```
  28.4% host_parse::parse_stream_fragment
  18.9% host_net::writev_coalesce
  12.2% epoll_wait
   9.1% grpc::stream_send
   6.0% kvcache::get_shard
   4.5% tokenizer::slice
```

alex: Note writev_coalesce spiked relative to baseline.

sam: Can you repro with a small request workload? e.g., 1-8 token responses at high qps.

alex: Repro steps (stresser):
```
# run ~200 concurrent clients, payload=short
python infra/tools/grpc_bench.py --concurrency 200 --seq-len 6 --rate 500 --duration 120 --host staging-redwood:443
```

alex: On staging this reproduces the tail bump within ~30s.

mira: Try toggling INGRESS_WRITEV_COALESCE back to old value (0.8 -> 0.95) in staging. If headroom is the issue, that should reduce flush frequency.

alex: Did that. Swapped env var -> rerun: tails returned to baseline (within noise). Good signal.

jordan: So change set was the scheduler micro-batch flush policy (commit 8f2c3d). We should bisect to be sure. Also add a unit-level sim for small-frame coalescing to avoid regressions.

alex: Filing a perf PR to revert the tweak and add a micro-batch regression test. Linking dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/d/host/ingress-writev?orgId=1

ci-bot: Canary rollback for deploy/ingress-scheduler (sha 8f2c3d) completed on staging :white_check_mark:

sam: Nice catch. After PR, let's also add a sampling histogram for writev size/time to the console so we can catch gradual regressions.

mira: Agreed. Also add a small e2e that runs the grpc_bench scenario on CI smoke for new scheduler changes.

alex: Will do. PR draft: https://git.redwood/infradev/ingress/pull/512 (includes perf trace & regression test).

jordan: :mag: once CI passes, ship it. Add release note about writev coalescing headroom.

alex: :shipit: Thanks all.

ci-bot: Deploy to production paused pending PR review (auto-flag: perf-regression).
